author: @Resologist
text: Forget Qatar and Bahrain. If Yanks need to buy aluminum, (or aluminium), the best place is the province of Quebec, in Canada. The United States once had a "free trade" agreement with Canada; and, Quebec has plenty of electric power to smelt aluminum, so Quebec made most of the aluminum that the United States imported. Then, Trump declared one of his fake "national emergency" tariffs of 50% on Canadian aluminum. That's why Yanks are going all the way, past the Gulf of Hormuz to get their aluminum, instead of across the border in (Quebec) Canada. If Trump can drop sanctions against Russian oil during this war, someone might be smart enough to end the tariff on Canadian aluminum. Nope, there's no one that smart in the White House. Hey, Yanks, enjoy your inflationary prices on aluminum products, (if you can get it past the Gulf of Hormuz), 'cause Trump doesn't like the "free trade" agreement you had with Canada, (that he signed in 2018).
